title: Moonbound Luna
excerpt: A rogue with no pack discovers the moon has chosen her for the one role she never wanted.

sections.title: Rogue
paragraphs: Nessa had survived three years without a pack by trusting no one who carried the scent of pine and smoke.
Then the full moon marked her wrist with a crescent of silver.
Every wolf in the valley knew what the mark meant before she did.

sections.title: The Choosing
paragraphs: The Alpha did not kneel when he found her, but everyone else did.
Nessa hated him for the fear in their eyes more than for the title he offered her.
A Luna, she learned, was not a queen. She was a promise the pack expected a woman to keep.

sections.title: A Different Pack
paragraphs: She accepted on one condition: no one would ever kneel to her again.
The elders called it disrespect. The youngest wolves called it hope.
By spring, the valley belonged to a different kind of pack.
